examples:
I'm not passionate about my product, because products can and do change all the time in response to business needs and market conditions, but I'm passionate about my vision that addresses the problem I'm trying to solve. If I see my vision realized in the world through my efforts, it would be satisfying for me to know I made a difference. What's a vision? It's simply an idea of how things can be different after the problem has been addressed by my solution.

At the same time, however, I'm also very passionate about money, and building my own team and company. If my startup fails and I have a chance, I'll just do another one.

I think in terms of motivation, having both is the best, but you can get by on one or the other. Having passion for a product may not be such a great idea since you can be easily convinced your product is the best solution when it doesn't fit the problem.

To all partners, contributors, and customers, we regret to inform you that DesignBold will be closing on 25 October 2021.

Founded in 2016, DesignBold aims to empower everyone from everywhere to create visual content limited only by their own imagination. We believe that every idea, if it can be thought, can be created; and it should be created beautifully by anyone who dares to dream it.. Designing should not be tough but somehow we are still bogged down with complicated, expensive software that puts design out of reach for most people. DesignBold provides an arsenal of tools that lets your team create beautiful designs as a whole. For enterprises, giving input, feedback and adapting designs have never been easier.

It’s a difficult decision
As a startup, DesignBold faced a lot of problems, and as the world reeled, we witnessed waves of rapidly evolving technologies, design tools, and business markets that demanded us to pivot for innovative exploration and catch the waves head-on. We failed to make DesignBold become a leading and popular design tool. This demands a difficult decision of closing the business to be made today.

Please download your designs before 25 October 2021
DesignBold tool will close after 25 October 2021. You should access your design dashboard and download all your designs.

To all customers, contributors, and partners in the past 5 years, we thank you all! May our paths cross again in the future. Goodbye, until we see you again.

Somebody could have their mid 20s crisis, for me, I guess I have more likely a self existential exploring progression 😂

For these amazing years, as I always said, I cannot thank you enough, ZA.

structures.pattern: Motivate
examples:
Maximize to the Maximum

The world has changed. Attention is the new measure of success, so releasing a half-hearted “Minimum Viable Product” no longer works. You need to wow people and keep their attention in a landscape of one trillion web sites and millions of apps.

You need to push yourself and your team to do the best work possible at all times. Even if you are the number one player, you need to push yourself to be better than your best. This is maximizing to the maximum. Unfortunately, most people maximize to the minimum, doing “just enough” to “get the job done.”

The day-to-day firefighting will wear you down, but that is no excuse. Set ambition goals each week, and exceed them. Create forcing functions that cause you to be better. Hire people that you can not afford, forcing you to increase revenues. Sell the CEO of a big customer when your product is not quite ready, pushing you to finish.

Push yourself and the business outside of your comfort zone, and then hustle to deliver world-class results. All of the great CEOs do this, from Elon Musk to Larry Page, and they are never satisfied with the results, even when they are on top. Good luck!
